whatsappMessage:
Hi Team White Chillies,

I noticed your dining business has a perfect 5.0★ rating in Patna, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile website for online menu browsing and direct table reservations.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme interactive menu, online takeaway ordering, aur direct WhatsApp table booking integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/whitechillies

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi White Chillies team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (White Chillies) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with a 5-star digital menu, direct WhatsApp reservations, and mobile-first speed for Patna food lovers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, prices aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
